caption: The drawing presents a rectangular band positioned horizontally in the center of a plain, beige background. The band is composed of several parallel horizontal strips featuring decorative patterns. From top to bottom, the first strip contains a repetitive light gray and white leaf or acanthus motif with dark gray and black shading, bordered above and below by narrower black and gray lines. Below this, a thin strip with a pattern of alternating dark and light gray curved elements is visible. The central and largest horizontal band is filled with a solid green color and is ornamented with a repeating, stylized, light green aline pattern resembling floral or vine motifs, mirrored along the length. Beneath this center band, another thin strip of alternating gray elements appears, identical to the one above. At the very bottom, a closely-packed pattern in dark gray and black forms a wavy texture, edged by another solid black line. The artist's signature is visible near the lower right corner of the plain background.
title: Wall Paper Border
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
